name: One-Hit Wonder
source:
A short visual novel for Game Boy written in Catalan language, the first of its kind.
Our protagonist joins a young man called Ismael in his nocturnal journey through a cyberpunk Barcelona... and down memory lane.
translation:
这是一部用加泰罗尼亚语编写的Game Boy视觉短篇小说，是此类小说中的第一部。
我们的主角与一位名叫伊斯梅尔的年轻人一起踏上赛博朋克巴塞罗那的夜间之旅……并沿着记忆之路前进。
